content: स्थापनम् [स्था-णिच्-ल्युट्] .²1 .³({%a%}) The act of causing to stand, fixing; founding, establishing, instituting; <ls>Mb. 12. 255. 3</ls>. .³({%b%}) Regulating, directing. .²2 Fixing the thoughts, concentration of the mind, steady application, abstraction. .²3 A dwelling, habitation. .²4 A ceremony performed on a womanʼs perceiving the first signs of living conception; <ab>cf.</ab> पुंसवन. .²5 Fastening, rendering immovable; उत्थापनैरुन्नयनैश्चालनैः स्थापनैरपि . परस्परं जिगीषन्तावुपचक्रतुरात्मनः .. <ls>Bhāg. 10. 44. 5</ls>. .²6 Founding, erecting (a temple, image <ab>&c.</ab>). .²7 Preservation, prolongation (of life). .²8 A means of stopping (the flow of blood), styptic. .²9 Storage (of grain). .²10 Establishment of a proposition.  {@वृत्त@} {%a.%} one who is past all restoration to strength.
